Hi Alice,

I found your email about the resume template request. I was able to access the resume templates website at www.resume-templates.com, which has download links available. However, I'm encountering some technical restrictions with downloading the actual template files from the portal site.

The website offers resume templates at https://www.resume-templates.com/download_links. You might be able to access and download the template directly from there, or I can try alternative methods to get the template to you.

Would you like me to try another approach, or do you have preferred way to receive the template?

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
